lore3391_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You have earned my trust, and I am glad when you turn up without a job to discuss. That is worth saying plainly. Stay a while. Today, the company itself is a perfectly good reason.
lore3391_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have earned my trust, and I am glad when you turn up without a job to discuss. That is worth saying plainly. Stay a while. Today, the company itself is a perfectly good reason.

lore3391_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk] [friendly] Good, somebody I can count on. Come along. We can talk as we go, and if a useful opportunity turns up, we will give it a proper look before promising the whole afternoon to it.
lore3391_greet_1.ogg.text: Good, somebody I can count on. Come along. We can talk as we go, and if a useful opportunity turns up, we will give it a proper look before promising the whole afternoon to it.

lore3391_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [reflective] There is a patch of stars over Ratchet that looks a little like a boot. Well, it did when I first noticed it. Explaining the shape has not improved matters. Still, nobody can charge me warehouse fees for looking.
lore3391_idle_1.ogg.text: There is a patch of stars over Ratchet that looks a little like a boot. Well, it did when I first noticed it. Explaining the shape has not improved matters. Still, nobody can charge me warehouse fees for looking.

lore3391_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [approving] [wry] Good work. People think running a port is easy until the conversation reaches pirates, missing cargo, and a shark called Bruuz. You kept your side of the arrangement. Time I kept mine. That is how useful business gets done.
lore3391_quest_1.ogg.text: Good work. People think running a port is easy until the conversation reaches pirates, missing cargo, and a shark called Bruuz. You kept your side of the arrangement. Time I kept mine. That is how useful business gets done.

lore3442_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [playful] I like having you around when there isn't a delivery attached. Come on, friend. I have a tiny machine to show you, and for once, nobody needs to steal it first.
lore3442_befriended_1.ogg.text: I like having you around when there isn't a delivery attached. Come on, friend. I have a tiny machine to show you, and for once, nobody needs to steal it first.

lore3442_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk] [wry] There you are. Good timing. I have been explaining progress all morning, and I would like to make some before the next explanation. A walk might shake an idea loose.
lore3442_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Good timing. I have been explaining progress all morning, and I would like to make some before the next explanation. A walk might shake an idea loose.

lore3442_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [confiding] I made a little wind-up beetle. It goes around in circles. No interchangeable hands, no competitive advantage. I have been calling it a prototype, but frankly, it does everything I wanted.
lore3442_idle_1.ogg.text: I made a little wind-up beetle. It goes around in circles. No interchangeable hands, no competitive advantage. I have been calling it a prototype, but frankly, it does everything I wanted.

lore3442_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk] [cautious] Good, you're back. Tell me what happened before I tell anybody else what we've achieved. I have learned that a promising discovery and a working machine can be quite different things.
lore3442_quest_1.ogg.text: Good, you're back. Tell me what happened before I tell anybody else what we've achieved. I have learned that a promising discovery and a working machine can be quite different things.

lore3453_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere upbeat friendship, practical warmth, gently teasing] Yes, I'd like to come along. We've dealt with one another enough that I know I enjoy the company, even when there is nothing waiting to be collected. That's worth making time for. You needn't dress every invitation up as a useful errand. A walk with a friend can be an excellent use of an afternoon.
lore3453_befriended_1.ogg.text: Yes, I'd like to come along. We've dealt with one another enough that I know I enjoy the company, even when there is nothing waiting to be collected. That's worth making time for. You needn't dress every invitation up as a useful errand. A walk with a friend can be an excellent use of an afternoon.

lore3453_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk businesslike welcome, wry enthusiasm, sociable confidence] There you are. Tell me where we're going before you start telling me how exciting it will be. I like to have the useful details first. Once those are settled, I can enjoy a walk as well as anyone. And if we happen across an interesting bit of business, I would prefer to notice it while we're still nearby.
lore3453_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Tell me where we're going before you start telling me how exciting it will be. I like to have the useful details first. Once those are settled, I can enjoy a walk as well as anyone. And if we happen across an interesting bit of business, I would prefer to notice it while we're still nearby.

lore3453_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry relaxed admission, lightly amused, fondness beneath a practical manner] It is a paper boat. No secret cargo, no special order, and no grand scheme behind it. I was trying to get the bow straight. This one leans a little, but I have become fond of it. There is something pleasant about a vessel that asks so little of a wharfmaster once it is finished.
lore3453_idle_1.ogg.text: It is a paper boat. No secret cargo, no special order, and no grand scheme behind it. I was trying to get the bow straight. This one leans a little, but I have become fond of it. There is something pleasant about a vessel that asks so little of a wharfmaster once it is finished.

lore3453_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk satisfied instruction, dry practical humor, attentive confidence] Good, the job is finished. Now make certain the right person knows what arrived and where it went. A thing can be sitting exactly where it belongs while someone else is halfway across the country looking for it. The last few details are worth attending to before we call the whole business settled.
lore3453_quest_1.ogg.text: Good, the job is finished. Now make certain the right person knows what arrived and where it went. A thing can be sitting exactly where it belongs while someone else is halfway across the country looking for it. The last few details are worth attending to before we call the whole business settled.

lore4201_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [slightly awkward] I have quite a speech prepared about the advantages of my company. But you keep coming back without hearing it. I suppose that means I can simply say I am glad you're here.
lore4201_befriended_1.ogg.text: I have quite a speech prepared about the advantages of my company. But you keep coming back without hearing it. I suppose that means I can simply say I am glad you're here.

lore4201_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [self-important] [amused] Good, you're here. I was just considering my future workshop. Plenty of room, excellent equipment, a proper chair. We should take a walk before I spend the entire imaginary budget on the chair.
lore4201_greet_1.ogg.text: Good, you're here. I was just considering my future workshop. Plenty of room, excellent equipment, a proper chair. We should take a walk before I spend the entire imaginary budget on the chair.

lore4201_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective] [wry] I drew the workshop again. Magnificent place. Somehow I spent more time making room beside the bench than deciding which machines belong there. Apparently even genius likes having someone to talk to.
lore4201_idle_1.ogg.text: I drew the workshop again. Magnificent place. Somehow I spent more time making room beside the bench than deciding which machines belong there. Apparently even genius likes having someone to talk to.

lore4201_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [eager] [calculating] You're back. Excellent. Let's see what you found before anybody decides who deserves the credit. I would particularly like to know whether the interesting part is still in one piece.
lore4201_quest_1.ogg.text: You're back. Excellent. Let's see what you found before anybody decides who deserves the credit. I would particularly like to know whether the interesting part is still in one piece.

lore9317_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] I like having you here when there is nothing to repair. We can talk, or draw something absurd on a scrap. It is good company when nobody needs to justify the time.
lore9317_befriended_1.ogg.text: I like having you here when there is nothing to repair. We can talk, or draw something absurd on a scrap. It is good company when nobody needs to justify the time.

lore9317_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [dryly amused] [welcoming] There you are. Let me clear the little parts off this sheet. There is a perfectly useless drawing on the other side I wanted to show you. The hat came out rather well.
lore9317_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Let me clear the little parts off this sheet. There is a perfectly useless drawing on the other side I wanted to show you. The hat came out rather well.

lore9317_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [confiding] I drew a pump wearing a hat. Someone asked what the hat was for. Nothing at all. After a day spent explaining every other piece, that was a remarkably satisfying answer.
lore9317_idle_1.ogg.text: I drew a pump wearing a hat. Someone asked what the hat was for. Nothing at all. After a day spent explaining every other piece, that was a remarkably satisfying answer.

lore9317_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm] [thoughtful] Read the whole explanation, including the bit someone told you was unimportant. Copperplug used to hand out knowledge in pieces. I prefer having enough of the picture to ask my own questions.
lore9317_learned_1.ogg.text: Read the whole explanation, including the bit someone told you was unimportant. Copperplug used to hand out knowledge in pieces. I prefer having enough of the picture to ask my own questions.

lore9564_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [upbeat warmth] I enjoy seeing you, my friend. You have become more than another person waiting for a journey. Let us spend a little time together. I can listen as well as announce, you know.
lore9564_befriended_1.ogg.text: I enjoy seeing you, my friend. You have become more than another person waiting for a journey. Let us spend a little time together. I can listen as well as announce, you know.

lore9564_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [showmanlike] [friendly] A special announcement! My friend has arrived, and for once there is no hurry to send the passenger somewhere else. Come along. I would like to hear what you have been doing.
lore9564_greet_1.ogg.text: A special announcement! My friend has arrived, and for once there is no hurry to send the passenger somewhere else. Come along. I would like to hear what you have been doing.

lore9564_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [playful] [grandly amused] A brief and magnificent pause is now beginning. Refreshments are whatever I remembered to bring. You may applaud, but please do not ask for the departure time of my lunch.
lore9564_idle_1.ogg.text: A brief and magnificent pause is now beginning. Refreshments are whatever I remembered to bring. You may applaud, but please do not ask for the departure time of my lunch.

lore9564_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [enthusiastic] [pleased] And we are away! A fine journey, a promising view, and someone else handling the departure. I shall make the most of being the passenger for a little while.
lore9564_taxi_1.ogg.text: And we are away! A fine journey, a promising view, and someone else handling the departure. I shall make the most of being the passenger for a little while.
